name: documents
description: Create and edit Word document artifacts (.docx) with duya's docx office skill.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export DOCX document artifacts locally. Ships a full OOXML toolkit: tracked changes, comments (add/extract/patch/strip), TOC and internal navigation, fields and cross-references, footnotes, captions, redaction, privacy scrub, watermarks, style lint/normalize, document protection, accessibility audit, and DOCX↔CSV/XLSX table interchange — each with a render-and-visually-verify playbook. Use Documents when the durable output or target is a document, doc, docs, Word file, memo, report, or writing artifact.
interface.shortDescription_zh: 创建和编辑 Word 文档
